title: Construct exact Pascal occurrence and owner addresses without materializing compiler classes
body:
## Result
Prove an exact arithmetic bijection for the ordered Pascal parent/child occurrences, plus ultimate-owner resolution in at most G+1 ancestry steps, without materializing occurrence buckets.

## Novelty and predecessors
#4359, #4691, #6878 establish finite compiler and layout ingredients; this makes the missing individual owner/occurrence identification explicit, preserving native and owned-field identities.

## Verification
242 finite flows, 9,934 owner checks, 10 negative controls and independent literal-word review. Run python3 -I -W error -B research/pascal-occurrence-codec/verify.py.

## Limits and kappa
Logical codec only: no physical routing or native service. No new kappa; 0.00363005817 remains conditional.

## Credit
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors and PRs as detailed in the package.

Full proof, reproducibility, negative controls and provenance: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/91246e5131152ccb1f64a969c36706360861f821/research/pascal-occurrence-codec
